### Identification

Under the BRNFFRCISTG with local row formation, and positivity, $\theta(\Gamma_{\mathbf t})$ is identified by the argument of Theorem 2 of [Nonparametric identification and estimation](#sec-id-bipartite-random-networks), with four covariates, $\mathbf R_s$, $\mathbf T_s$, $\mathbf M_s$ and $\mathbf V_s$, following each week's graph generator rather than one: a product of one kernel per covariate, for the places' risk ratings and the people's messages and vaccination, and one row kernel per week, with the factors of the intervened decisions $T_{sj}$ deleted. Positivity is needed on the cells the regime visits: for the messages, each combination of a person's history and of the network value of the drives they are exposed to; for the rows, each combination of a person's vaccination status and previous row. Because the regime changes who is vaccinated, and so where people go, the row kernel is needed at pasts the realized network may not show for the same person; under local row formation it is enough that some person shows them ([Remark 7](#rem-rows)). Time homogeneity, an assumption of this example only, lets the kernels be pooled across weeks as well as across people.
